result.problems: (1) The frozen shortlist is empty on both timeframes, so every column read is outside it (labelled everywhere); any re-opening is a user decision. (2) The family SPA p (0.0015) is carried by the jump4 cell and is a within-session statistic that section 7b shows is inflated for a first-SETUP-of-the-session rule (session_stop R.3); it is the only go/no-go item the family passes and cannot carry a candidate. (3) The chop-state rule as designed has no minimum-support guard, so hmm4's in-sample chop is a 37-row state (22 skipped at tau 0.9); reported as such, not repaired (a guard would be a new registration). (4) For hard-state jump models the tau grid is degenerate: 5 identical masks per model in the ledger (design grid kept; effective trials 1.80). (5) harness.score_paths writes CPCV rows without a note; their config.vocabulary carries the label (verified on all 89 rows). (6) Other phase-3 studies append to the ledger concurrently, so the current ledger sha differs from the after-sha recorded at the end of this run; the 89 rows are unchanged (append-only). (7) A smoke run was made on a redirected scratchpad ledger with the L1 nets shuffled within IS (no real number off-ledger); its outputs are in the scratchpad, not the study folder.
